final_message:
I wrote the gap analysis report. It maps all 47 Undertaking commitments against the Remediation Plan and finds a gap in every one: 10 Critical, 9 High, 21 Medium and 7 Low. Two commitments have no Plan action at all (C17 sub-processor due diligence, C47 children's data assessment). Other Critical gaps include a 72-hour escalation chain against the required 24 hours (C33), TLS 1.2 where TLS 1.3 is required (C2), and the DPO reporting through the parent company's General Counsel (C38). The report also covers missed extension and notice deadlines, unfunded items, errors in the mapping matrix, and a dated action list; it validates and parses back cleanly.
